changelog:
* Feat: Bancontact, iDEAL, MyBank, Satispay, Wero, Bizum and Scalapay are only displayed when the cart amount and the billing country are allowed by the PayPlug account, on the classic and the blocks checkout
* Feat: merchants can narrow the cart amount range and the billing countries of each of these payment methods in the PayPlug settings
* Change: these payment methods are hidden when no billing country is known, when the cart is not in EUR, and until their limits have been fetched from the PayPlug account (login, opening or saving the PayPlug settings, plugin update); Scalapay no longer uses built-in amount limits
